identity.title: Verify non-contiguous Mat stride ROI input ownership contract

origin.summary: 2D-028 requires focused proof for non-contiguous Mat views, padded stride, ROI input, disposed inputs, and independent output ownership without reopening the PL-0006 converter implementation.

state.current_summary: 2D-028 is complete as a focused converter ownership contract. Existing BitmapImageConverter behavior now has explicit evidence for non-contiguous ROI/padded-step pixels, caller/output independence, and disposed-input rejection; PL-0006 production behavior was not reopened.

objective.summary: Prove that supported non-contiguous Mat/ROI and padded-stride conversions preserve visible pixels and row boundaries, reject disposed or unsupported inputs explicitly, do not release or mutate caller-owned inputs, and return independently owned outputs.
constraints: Reuse src/OpenVisionLab/Common/Imaging/BitmapImageConverter.cs and the existing VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke bitmap converter contract.
Do not reopen or rewrite PL-0006, add zero-copy or unsafe architecture, or introduce a new image abstraction.
Use isolated evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev; do not touch Original, release, deploy, hardware, or external systems.

criteria.text: Continuous and non-contiguous ROI/padded-stride Mat and Bitmap inputs preserve visible pixel values and leave guard rows/columns unchanged; unsupported formats or disposed inputs fail explicitly without an output being returned.
Conversion never disposes or mutates caller-owned input storage, and an allocated output remains usable after the caller releases its input.
The focused Debug/Release contract passes and the owner/call path plus unverified WPF/runtime boundary are recorded in the stable contract and handoff documents.

evidence.observation: Debug D: executable contract passed 3/3: ROI and padded-stride pixels/guards, caller and output ownership, and disposed Bitmap/Mat rejection.
Release D: executable contract passed 3/3 with the same ROI/stride, ownership, and disposed-input coverage.

The existing PL-0006 regression contract passed 5/5 in both Debug and Release, preserving odd-width indexed guards, signed Bitmap stride, padded/submatrix destinations, color/palette conversion, round trips, and unsupported-format behavior.
The owner/call path, mutable-state and lifetime ownership, acceptance scope, D: evidence, build warnings, and unverified WPF/runtime boundaries are recorded; the next slice is 2D-029.

events.summary: Keep BitmapImageConverter as the sole conversion owner and add only a focused MatViewOwnershipContract; do not reopen PL-0006 or introduce zero-copy/image abstractions.
All 2D-028 criteria are satisfied by Debug/Release 3/3 focused contracts, PL-0006 5/5 regression contracts, and documented owner/lifetime boundaries.
